# Kinetic Bay

> Chennai-headquartered technology company that builds custom software, AI, cloud and industrial IoT systems for businesses in India and worldwide. Tagline: Building Machines. Shaping Humans.

Kinetic Bay designs and engineers technology around how an organisation actually works, rather than forcing the organisation to fit the software. Work spans four engineering pillars plus five ready-to-deploy products, all customisable. Delivery is aligned with the UN Sustainable Development Goals.

- Founded and headquartered in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India
- Serves clients across India and internationally, remote-first with on-site visits when needed
- 40+ projects delivered, 99% success rate
- Contact: kineticbay@gmail.com | https://kineticbay.in/contact
- Free discovery call, NDA on request, response within 24 hours

## Services

- [AI & Automation](https://kineticbay.in/services/ai-automation): AI chatbots, autonomous agents, LLM fine-tuning and workflow automation built on the client's own data.
- [Digital Engineering](https://kineticbay.in/services/digital-engineering): Custom web apps, mobile apps, SaaS products and enterprise integrations.
- [Cybersecurity & Cloud](https://kineticbay.in/services/cybersecurity-cloud): Azure and AWS cloud-native development, cloud migration, DevSecOps and VAPT penetration testing.
- [Industrial IoT](https://kineticbay.in/services/iot): Predictive maintenance, asset tracking, energy monitoring and smart buildings.

## Products

- [Kinetic HRMS](https://kineticbay.in/products/hrms): HRMS with payroll, Indian statutory compliance, leave and performance management.
- [Kinetic VMS](https://kineticbay.in/products/vms): Visitor management with QR pre-registration, ID verification, badges and host alerts.
- [Kinetic PMS](https://kineticbay.in/products/pms): Project management with task boards, Gantt charts, timesheets and dashboards.
- [Kinetic CRM](https://kineticbay.in/products/crm): CRM with lead capture, automated follow-ups and WhatsApp readiness.
- [Kinetic Attendance](https://kineticbay.in/products/attendance): Face recognition, biometric, RFID and GPS attendance that syncs into payroll.

## Frequently asked questions

**How much does a custom software project cost?** Every project is different, so Kinetic Bay gives a clear, fixed-scope quotation after a free discovery session, with the full cost known upfront and no hidden charges.

**How long does it take to build a solution?** A proof of concept can be ready in 2 to 4 weeks. Most custom applications launch in 2 to 6 months depending on scope. Ready-made products can be deployed and customised in weeks.

**Will the client own the source code?** Yes. On custom development projects, full ownership of the source code and intellectual property is transferred to the client.

**How is data kept secure?** Kinetic Bay signs an NDA before any engagement, follows secure coding standards, uses role-based access controls, and designs systems in line with India's data protection law and global best practices.

**Can the products be customised for a specific industry?** Yes. HRMS, VMS, PMS, CRM and Attendance can all be tailored: workflows, fields, reports, branding and integrations.

**Does Kinetic Bay work outside Chennai or India?** Yes. Clients are served across India and around the world.

**What happens after a project goes live?** Ongoing support, maintenance and enhancement plans with defined response times.

**Can Kinetic Bay integrate with existing software?** Yes, including ERPs, accounting tools, payment gateways, biometric devices and third-party APIs.
